title: A Chance Encounter
next_chapter_hook: Ling Yuan's disheveled retreating silhouette vanished into the night, yet his words about the Great Zhou Dragon Court and Chen Tianming struck like a blade, embedding themselves deep into the softest corner of Chen Ji's heart.

text.content: The night wind sliced like a blade, tearing through the silence of the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain. Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back at the Cliff Edge, his robes flapping loudly, his eyes reflecting the brightly lit Sect Grand Hall in the distance. The Great Zhou Dragon Court—a name nearly forgotten in historical records—now hung above his head like a sword, making him truly understand what it felt like to walk on thin ice.

"It seems the plan needs to be advanced." Chen Ji murmured softly, his fingers unconsciously stroking the yellowed Tianji Record Fragment in his sleeve. The Three Great Sects' infighting, the Demonic Path invasion, the opening of the Ancient Forbidden Land—behind this seemingly chaotic chess game, there was an invisible hand manipulating it all. And he, too, was merely a single piece on this grand game.

dialogue.content: "Oh? Isn't this our Tianqing Sect's renowned 'waste' Chen Ji? Standing alone here in the deep night, could you be missing someone?"

text.content: That voice was aged yet full of vitality, carrying an overbearing pressure from above. Chen Ji slowly turned around to see a figure in blue robes pacing out from the darkness. The visitor had white hair and beard, a gaunt face—appearing somewhat immortal at first glance, but those narrow eyes concealed unmistakable cruelty and scheming. It was the former Sect Master of Tianqing Sect—Ling Yuan.

dialogue.content: "Former Sect Master visits at this late hour, I wonder what brings you here?" Chen Ji slightly cupped his hands in greeting, his tone cold and indifferent as water, as if merely greeting an ordinary Sect elder.

Ling Yuan stroked his beard, gazing at Chen Ji with a smile that was neither genuine nor feigned: "This old one came on orders, wanting to see what manner of extraordinary talent our Tianqing Sect's most 'outstanding' disciple in a century truly possesses. But looking now—" He paused, his eyes flickering sharply, "truly 'well-deserved reputation,' indeed."

text.content: His words dripped with sarcasm—anyone could hear the mockery. Yet Chen Ji seemed not to understand, simply saying: "Former Sect Master overpraises. I wonder whose orders bring you 'on orders'?" At this, the smile on Ling Yuan's face stiffened slightly, clearly not expecting this waste to dare question back.

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan's reaction made Chen Ji instantly capture something. Faced with this old fox who appeared protective yet harbored hidden malice, how should he respond?

choices.text: Retreat to Advance, Playing Weak to Devour the Strong
choices.description: Continue feigning cowardice and ignorance as a worthless disciple, letting Ling Yuan relax his guard while secretly observing his true intentions.
choices.risk_hint: The Other Party May See Through the Disguise

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his eyes, adopting an expression of fearful reverence: "Your disciple is foolish, embarrassing the Former Sect Master. I only wonder why you've come at this late hour. If the Sect has any commands, your disciple would walk through fire without hesitation." His tone was extremely humble, as if truly a soft persimmon anyone could squeeze.

choices.text: Lay Cards Directly on the Table, Intimidate the Opponent
choices.description: No longer conceal, crush Ling Yuan with absolute strength, letting him know who the true powerhouse is.

text.content: The corner of Chen Ji's mouth lifted slightly, that smile gone in an instant yet carrying a chilling coldness that made one's heart race: "Since the Former Sect Master has come, perhaps your disciple might also witness the Tianqing Sect Former Sect Master's formidable moves." Before the words even finished, an invisible pressure poured from within him, pressing down upon Ling Yuan like a mountain.

choices.description: No动手, only words. Use words to pierce Ling Yuan's sore spots, making him embarrassed before everyone.

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly let out a light laugh, the sound especially harsh in the silent night: 'Elder is right, disciple indeed misses someone.' He paused, his gaze sharp as a blade, 'Someone chosen by the Tianji Record, yet hated by some until today. Elder, wouldn't you say so?'

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan's face instantly darkened, a glint of killing intent flashing in those turbid old eyes: 'What a sharp tongue. No wonder you dare act so presumptuous before me.' He stepped forward, spiritual pressure surging around him, 'But do you think your little cleverness can challenge me?'

text.content: The spiritual pressure crashed like a tide, and if it were an ordinary Foundation Building disciple, they would have been crushed to their knees. Yet Chen Ji stood immovable like a reef, not even his robe corners fluttering. He raised his eyes to look at Ling Yuan, his gaze terrifyingly calm: 'Elder's spiritual pressure seems not what it used to be.'

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan's pupils contracted sharply, gazing at the young man before him in disbelief. The next moment, an even more terrifying aura erupted from within Chen Ji—that was the aura of Great Perfection of Foundation Building, yet far more condensed and terrifying than ordinary Great Perfection. Ling Yuan's spiritual pressure was instantly torn apart, and he stumbled back several steps, nearly falling to the ground.

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan retreated in disarray, his face full of shock and disbelief. How should Chen Ji handle the aftermath?

choices.text: Press the advantage and completely overwhelm
choices.description: Give Ling Yuan no breathing room, directly suppress him utterly, making him lose all face.

text.content: Chen Ji stepped forward, spiritual power churning around him like raging waves. He raised his hand, and a brilliant sword light condensed at his fingertips. Though not truly swung, that razor-sharp sword intent made Ling Yuan's hair stand on end. 'Elder, you just said you wished to witness disciple's abilities?' Chen Ji's voice was cold as ice, 'Then please, Elder, grant me your guidance.'

choices.text: Stop at the right point, leave room for maneuver
choices.description: Display strength but don't be merciless, give Ling Yuan a way out, while letting him know he's not to be trifled with.
choices.visible_cost: Ling Yuan may harbor delusions of侥幸
choices.risk_hint: The other party may return for another round

text.content: Chen Ji slowly withdrew his aura, that suffocating spiritual pressure ebbing like a tide. He stepped back, standing once more at the cliff's edge, as if everything just now was merely an illusion. 'Elder, please forgive me. Disciple was merely restless and wanted to stretch my bones.' His tone returned to the earlier plainness, even carrying a hint of apology, 'I wonder what brings Elder here at this late hour?'

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan's face turned ashen, his eyes fixed intently on Chen Ji, complex emotions flickering within. After a long while, he suddenly coldly laughed: 'Good, good, good! This old man truly underestimated you.' He straightened his robes, regaining some composure, 'But do you think this is over? This old man's visit tonight was not merely to test you.'

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes flickered slightly, his expression unchanged: 'Oh? I'm all ears.' On the surface he remained calm, but internally he was already on guard. Ling Yuan was old and cunning; since he dared to visit at night, he must have some backing. If it were merely a test, why set up such a show?

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan stood with hands behind his back, a meaningful smile curling at his lips: 'The Holy Sect is quite impressed with Young Friend Chen, and has specifically sent this old man to recruit you. As long as Young Friend Chen is willing to submit, the Holy Sect can provide unlimited resources to help you break through to Golden Core—within reach.' He paused, then shifted topics, 'Of course, if Young Friend Chen doesn't know what's good for him... then this old man can only handle this officially.'

text.content: Upon hearing this, a glint of mockery flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. This old fox, superficially claiming recruitment, but actually testing his bottom line. Besides—Holy Sect? Chen Ji coldly smiled internally; wasn't the Holy Sect backed by the Great Zhou Dragon Court? It seemed tonight's play was far more interesting than he imagined.

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan extended the Holy Sect's olive branch, superficially recruiting but actually threatening. How should Chen Ji respond?

choices.text: Play along tactically to extract intelligence
choices.description: Pretend to be interested in the Holy Sect, and extract more intelligence about the Holy Sect and Long Ting from Ling Yuan.
choices.risk_hint: Might be seen through by Ling Yuan

text.content: Chen Ji shows a contemplative expression, as if seriously considering Ling Yuan's proposal. After a moment, he slowly speaks: "I appreciate the Holy Sect's kindness, disciple. I only wonder why the Holy Sect values this worthless one so much? Could it be... that the Holy Sect knows something that I do not?" He deliberately shows curiosity, though his eyes remain cold.

choices.description: Unhesitatingly reject the Holy Sect's recruitment, showing contempt for the Holy Sect.
choices.visible_cost: Completely become enemies with the Holy Sect
choices.risk_hint: The Holy Sect may increase pressure

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughs out loud, the sound echoing through the night sky with unmistakable mockery. "The Holy Sect?" He shakes his head, eyes full of contempt. "Elder, you overestimate the Holy Sect. Though this disciple lacks talent, I have not fallen so low as to rely on the Demonic Path." The words are absolute, allowing no room for negotiation.

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan's expression shifts slightly, clearly not expecting Chen Ji to refuse so decisively. He snorts coldly: "Chen Ji, do you think you alone can oppose the Holy Sect? Do not forget—your sister is still in the Holy Sect's hands!" At these words, Chen Ji's gaze turns sharp, killing intent radiating from him without restraint.

text.content: The air seems to freeze, a cold aura spreading from Chen Ji in all directions. He speaks word by word: "What did you say?" The voice is terrifyingly calm, yet strikes fear into the heart. Ling Yuan unconsciously steps back, beads of cold sweat appearing on his forehead. How can this waste have such terrifying presence?

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan forces himself to remain calm, sneering: "What? Angry? It seems you care deeply for your sister." He deliberately provokes Chen Ji. "But do not worry—as long as you comply, your sister will be safe in her position as the Heavenly Fate Key. But if you refuse the offered wine and choose the cup of wine..." He does not finish, but the threat is self-evident.

Chen Ji suddenly withdraws all his presence, as if the earlier cold aura was merely an illusion. He walks slowly toward Ling Yuan, each step measured and rhythmic, his voice terrifyingly calm: "Elder, you said one thing correctly." He stops before Ling Yuan, looking down on this once-arrogant elder. "I do care deeply for my sister."

text.content: "So—" Chen Ji bends down, leaning close to Ling Yuan's ear, voice low enough for only the two to hear. "If even a single hair on my sister is harmed, I will make the entire Holy Sect pay with their lives. Elder, do you believe me?" The words are spoken lightly, yet they make Ling Yuan's hair stand on end. What does he see in Chen Ji's eyes? A bottomless abyss of darkness, and—absolute confidence.

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan's pupils contract sharply, and he instinctively steps back several paces. He stares fixedly at Chen Ji as if seeing him for the first time. After a long moment, he suddenly bursts into laughter, though the sound carries embarrassment and anger: "Good, good Chen Ji! This old man was mistaken about you!" He turns, robes sweeping as he departs. "Today's matter—this old man remembers. Farewell!"

text.content: Ling Yuan's figure vanishes into the night, but Chen Ji remains standing, hands clasped behind his back. The night wind stirs his robes, yet cannot move the deep cold in his eyes. After a long silence, he murmurs: "Heavenly Fate Key... So this is why Xiao Nian was taken to the Holy Sect." His fists slowly clench, knuckles whitening. "Long Ting, Holy Sect... What are you planning?"

dialogue.content: At this moment, an elderly voice speaks in Chen Ji's mind: "Boy, your performance just now was quite impressive." It is Mo Xiansheng's voice, carrying a hint of approval. "But are you certain you want to completely antagonize the Holy Sect? Remember, your sister is still in their hands." A slight smile curves Chen Ji's lips: "Antagonize? Between the Holy Sect and myself, it was already a fight to the death long ago."

text.content: Mo Xiansheng falls silent for a moment, then slowly says: "You see things clearly. But this old man must warn you—the Great Zhou Long Ting's involvement means this matter is far more complex than you imagine. Your sister, the Heavenly Fate Key, may be the key to the entire game." Chen Ji nods, a firm light flickering in his eyes: "I understand. Whatever Long Ting plans, I will save Xiao Nian."

Stars twinkle in the night sky as Chen Ji turns to gaze at the brightly lit hall deep within the sect. Ling Yuan's狼狈 departure is merely a beginning. Holy Sect, Long Ting, the Three Great Sects... The chess game grows larger and more dangerous. But he fears nothing, for he is Chen Ji—a chess master who calculates without error. He walks slowly into the depths of night, his silhouette lonely yet resolute. "The Great Zhou Long Ting... How interesting."
